I am a UBC Sauder BCom alumni joining the MDS program after working for 2 years as a Policy Analyst in the BC Government. Throughout my time as a Policy Analyst and during co-ops at Sauder, TRIUMF, Canucks Sports and Entertainment, and the Vancouver Fraser Port Authority, I always gravitated toward questions that required data to solve. I am here to specialize and make that data-driven problem solving a career.
